console.logout.confirm.title: Discard unsaved settings?
console.logout.confirm.body: Signing out discards configuration changes that haven't been saved.
console.leave.title: Save settings before leaving?
console.leave.body: You have unsaved configuration changes. They stay on this page until you reload or sign out.
console.signin.title: Enter the console
console.signin.local: This server uses local authentication. Open the one-time sign-in link printed in the server console at startup.
console.signin.oauth: Sign in with your game account. Only the server owner and administrators they appoint can enter.
console.signin.continue_in_popup: Finish signing in in the new window. You'll be taken in here automatically.
console.signin.popup_blocked: The browser blocked the new window. Click here: %[1]s
console.signin.no_permissions: The server owner hasn't given you any permissions yet.
console.mail.recipient.none: No player can receive mail yet. Players appear here after they first sign in to the game.
console.mail.search.placeholder: Name, ID, category or alias; separate words with spaces
console.mail.search.label: Search items
console.mail.items.none_in_category: Only “%[1]s” is shown. Try switching back to “All”.
console.mail.detail.currency: Added straight to the account balance when the mail is claimed; no inventory item is created.
console.mail.detail.direct: Sends this item directly (no box to open)
console.mail.parcel.empty: Pick an item from the catalog to put it here
console.mail.presets.title: Click to set this quantity; Shift-click to add it
console.mail.letter.title: Mail title
console.mail.pick_first: Pick an item to send from the catalog first.
console.mail.sent: Sent to UID %[1]s. The player can claim it after refreshing the in-game mailbox; no server restart needed.
console.mail.inventory.hint: Affects only this player and takes effect the next time they sign in to the game; no server restart needed. Turning it off restores the player's original capacity.
console.mail.inventory.no_permission: You don't have permission to change inventory capacity
console.mail.inventory.saved: Saved the setting for UID %[1]s. It takes effect after the player signs in to the game again.
console.mail.log.title: Sent this session
console.mail.log.empty: Items you send are listed here. Click a grant ID to copy it.
console.mail.log.again_title: Put this item and quantity back on the slip
console.mail.log.identity_title: Click to copy the grant ID
console.roster.title: Players
console.roster.lead: Appoint administrators by game account; they sign in to the console with their own game account. Administrators can send mail and view players by default; the owner grants any other permission one by one.
console.roster.search.label: Filter players
console.roster.col.name: Name
console.roster.empty: No players yet. Players appear here after they first sign in to the game.
console.roster.revoke.title: Revoke administrator?
console.roster.revoke.body: UID %[1]s will be signed out of the console immediately and must be appointed again to return.
console.roster.appointed: UID %[1]s is now an administrator (can send mail and view players by default)
console.roster.permissions_updated: Updated permissions for UID %[1]s; effective immediately
console.roster.unlimited_on: Unlimited inventory turned on for UID %[1]s; takes effect at their next game sign-in
console.roster.unlimited_off: Unlimited inventory turned off for UID %[1]s; takes effect at their next game sign-in
console.permission.players.view.label: View players
console.permission.players.view.help: See the player list, UIDs and inventory settings.
console.permission.mail.send.label: Send mail
console.permission.mail.send.help: Send items and currency to any player.
console.permission.players.inventory.hel: Turn unlimited inventory capacity on or off for any player.
console.permissions.title: Permissions for UID %[1]s
console.permissions.configuration_help: Granted per group. Edit includes view; groups without view permission are hidden from this administrator.
console.permissions.owner_only: Appointing and revoking administrators and the server overview are owner-only and cannot be granted.
console.config.add_other: Other scope, press Enter to add
console.config.example.gold: Topping up %[1]s paid diamonds costs %[2]s gold
console.config.example.diamonds: Topping up %[1]s paid diamonds costs %[2]s regular diamonds
console.config.banner.pending.title: Saved; waiting for a restart
console.config.banner.pending.body: Changes to %[1]s have been written to disk, but the running server still uses the old settings. They take effect after the server process restarts.
console.config.banner.readonly.body: The server can't write this file (for example, it is mounted read-only), so it can only be viewed here.
console.config.banner.broken.title: The file on disk is currently invalid
console.config.banner.broken.body: The file was changed outside the console to something the server can't load, so the next restart will fail. Fix the problems below and save.
console.config.diff.title: Unsaved changes
console.config.diff.body: After saving, the server must be restarted for changes to take effect.
console.config.discard.title: Discard all changes?
console.config.discard.body: Unsaved configuration changes will be lost.
console.config.save.title: Save settings?
console.config.save.body: This writes %[1]s. Changes take effect after the server restarts; make sure the settings are right before restarting.
console.config.saved: %[1]s saved; takes effect after the server restarts
console.config.conflict.title: The file has changed
console.config.conflict.body: %[1]s was changed by someone or something else while you were editing. Loading the latest version discards your changes to this file.
console.overview.title: Server overview
config.problem.range_between: Must be a whole number from %[1]s to %[2]s
config.problem.forbidden: You don't have permission to change this group
config.problem.environment: The environment variable %[1]s isn't set in the running server process. Set it in the server environment before restarting after you save.
config.problem.environment_key: The environment variable %[1]s in the running server process isn't a valid base64-encoded 32-byte key; the server will refuse to start after a restart.
config.problem.missing_file: The server can't currently read this file: %[1]s
config.problem.message.bare_host: Enter only the host name, without scheme, path or port
config.problem.message.plaintext_listen_: Plaintext mode can only listen on a loopback address
config.problem.message.plaintext_host_lo: In plaintext mode the public address must be a loopback IP
config.problem.message.tls_required: Required unless local plaintext mode is enabled
config.problem.message.required_by_provi: Required when third-party moderation is enabled
config.problem.message.lowercase_identif: Use only lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter
config.problem.message.local_no_oauth: Can't be set in local mode
config.problem.message.oauth_provider: Enable at least one sign-in provider
config.problem.message.absolute_origin: Use a root address without a path, for example https://game.example.com
config.problem.message.https_origin: Must use HTTPS except on localhost
config.problem.message.positive_duration: Must be a positive duration, for example 15m or 720h
config.problem.message.official_origin: Official mode can only use the official address
config.problem.message.required_server_m: Required when using a self-hosted resource source
config.problem.message.absolute_url: Use a full HTTP(S) address without credentials, query or fragment
config.problem.message.no_trailing_slash: Must not end with a slash
config.problem.message.https_url: Must use HTTPS except for loopback addresses
config.problem.message.present: Must be written explicitly in the file
config.problem.message.hidden_section: A group you can't access has a problem. Ask the server owner to fix it.
config.game.title: Game rules
config.game.summary: Server-wide gameplay rules. Changes take effect after the server restarts.
config.game.section.story.title: Opening chapter
config.game.section.story.help: Stored permanently in the server state after the first successful initialization and can't be changed afterwards; deleting the database doesn't switch the opening.
config.game.field.story.start_pack_id.op: The current client's default opening, using that story's quests and tutorial flow.
Uses that chapter's opening story, starting quests and card-purchase rewards from the current GameData.
config.game.lock.story.start_pack_id: Stored permanently in the server state after the first initialization; can no longer be changed
config.game.section.gacha.title: Gacha
config.game.field.gacha.include_collabor: Add collab signature weapons to guaranteed UR equipment tickets

Adds 14 collaboration characters' UR signature weapons (equipment 943200–943213) to the original pool, each with the existing per-item weight for its rarity. Only changes the ticket's candidate pool; no equipment is granted directly.
config.game.section.purchases.title: Paid diamond top-ups
config.game.section.purchases.help: Regular cash products always cost paid diamonds, priced from GameData; this only sets how paid diamond top-ups themselves are exchanged.
config.game.field.purchases.diamond_rech: Charges no currency and grants the selected top-up product's original reward directly.
Each regular paid diamond costs the configured amount of gold.
Each regular paid diamond costs the configured amount of regular diamonds.
Blocks buying paid diamond top-up products; paid diamonds players already own are unaffected.
Cost of each regular paid diamond when exchanging for gold. Must be valid even when not selected.
Cost of each regular paid diamond when exchanging for regular diamonds. Must be valid even when not selected.
config.game.section.realtime.title: Real-time multiplayer
config.game.section.realtime.help: Native TCP/UDP connections used by action minigames, online fishing and random defense. When off, no real-time ports are opened, which affects the player experience.
config.game.field.realtime.enabled.label: Enable real-time multiplayer
config.game.field.realtime.public_host.h: The host name players can reach, without scheme, path or port.
config.game.field.realtime.tcp_listen.he: The public port may differ from the listen port, for port forwarding.
config.game.field.realtime.tls_cert_file: A certificate matching the public host name and trusted by the client. Relative paths are resolved from the directory containing game.json; new handshakes pick up updates automatically.
The private key stays on the server and must be readable by the server process.
config.game.field.realtime.development_p: Local development only: both the listen and public addresses must be loopback IPs, and no certificate is needed.
config.game.section.text_moderation.help: Local rules run first; the third-party service is called only if they pass. Existing nicknames and bios aren't re-checked at sign-in.
config.game.field.text_moderation.rule_f: UTF-8 .txt (one word per line, substring match) or .json (match mode and scope per entry), up to 4 MiB per file. Relative paths are resolved from the directory containing game.json.
config.game.field.text_moderation.provid: Connects a self-hosted moderation service or a third-party adapter gateway.
Use HTTPS; HTTP is allowed only for loopback addresses, and redirects aren't followed. For Azure, enter the resource's root address.
The server reads the key from this environment variable; the key itself is never stored in the configuration file.
The Authorization header sends Bearer <key>; any other header name passes the key as is.
The third party only checks the input sources listed explicitly.
The client reports that moderation is temporarily unavailable.
Lets through text that passed the local rules; explicit rejections are never let through.
Text is rejected when any category reaches this severity; 0 rejects even results with severity 0.
config.game.section.format.title: Format
config.game.field.schema_version.label: Format version
config.authentication.title: Sign-in and authentication
config.authentication.summary: How players sign in. Changes take effect after the server restarts; secrets are read only from environment variables and never written to this file.
config.authentication.section.mode.title: Authentication mode
config.authentication.field.mode.label: Mode
No sign-in; there is a single local player.
Players sign in with Discord or Google, and the server can host many players.
config.authentication.field.public_url.h: The root address used by players and OAuth callbacks, without a path; must use HTTPS except on localhost.
config.authentication.field.master_key_e: This environment variable must hold a base64-encoded 32-byte key used to encrypt sign-in data.
config.authentication.section.session.he: Use Go duration format, for example 15m or 720h. Leave empty to use the default.
config.resources.title: Client resources
config.resources.summary: Where the client downloads ServerData and GameData. Changes take effect after the server restarts; version numbers come from versions.json and aren't set here.
config.resources.section.source.title: Resource source
config.resources.field.mode.label: Mode
config.resources.field.mode.option.offic: Uses the official resource addresses for the current version.
config.resources.field.mode.option.serve: Downloads from a static CDN or caching reverse proxy provided by the server owner.
config.resources.field.server_data_url.h: An absolute HTTP(S) address without a trailing slash; must use HTTPS except for loopback addresses.
config.resources.field.game_data_url.hel: An absolute HTTP(S) address without a trailing slash; must use HTTPS except for loopback addresses.
config.updates.title: Updates
config.updates.summary: How new releases are checked, pre-downloaded and installed during maintenance. Checking and downloading don't affect the game; applying an update must be confirmed in the console or on the command line. Changes take effect after the server restarts.
config.updates.section.check.title: Checking and downloading
config.updates.field.check.label: Check for new releases automatically
config.updates.field.check.help: Checks the release manifest at startup and then at the configured interval, with a random offset.
config.updates.field.download.label: Download in advance
config.updates.field.download.help: Downloads and verifies a new release in the background so applying the update doesn't have to wait.
config.updates.field.manifest_url.label: Release manifest URL
config.updates.field.manifest_url.help: Leave empty to use the built-in address; the manifest signature must verify against the built-in public key.
config.updates.field.changelog_urls.help: Tried in order; leave empty to use the built-in GitHub and Gitea addresses.
config.updates.section.install.title: Installation
config.updates.field.method.label: Install method
config.updates.field.method.option.nativ: Replaces the program files and exits so systemd restarts the new version; automatically switches back to the previous program if that fails.
config.updates.field.method.option.docke: Drains, saves and exits; a host script then switches to the image named in the manifest.
Only checks and displays releases; updates can't be applied.
config.updates.field.webhook_url.label: Webhook URL
config.updates.field.webhook_url.help: POST JSON once to this URL when a new release is found; leave empty to send nothing.
console.updates.title: Updates
console.updates.lead: The server checks the signed release manifest at an interval and can download and verify releases ahead of time. Applying an update first notifies online players, closes new sign-ins, drains requests and saves, then switches to the new version.
console.updates.outcome.rolled_back: Rolled back to the previous program
console.updates.confirm_irreversible: I have read the migration note and understand it can't be rolled back
console.updates.apply.title: Apply the server update?
console.updates.apply.body_countdown: Once preparation finishes, a %[1]s-minute countdown starts: online players see a maintenance notice, new sign-ins close in the last minute, then the server drains, saves and switches to %[2]s.
console.updates.apply.body_now: Once preparation finishes, the server immediately closes new sign-ins, drains, saves and switches to %[1]s.
console.updates.schedules.title: Schedules
console.updates.schedules.confirm: After preparation, wait %[1]s minutes, drain and save, then restart the current server with schedule set %[2]s.
console.error.incompatible_schedules: This schedule set does not match the running game and GameData versions.
console.error.confirming_update: The previous update is still being checked. Wait until it is confirmed healthy.
console.updates.restarting: The server is restarting to apply the update. This page reconnects automatically.
